name: inflate
title: Inflate
description: A flat sliver puffs up like a balloon toy, squashes and settles into a glossy mark, then the wordmark slides out. The mark is a fixed rounded square with a dot; the wordmark is the text variable.
useWhen: A consumer, kids or casual app wants a soft, bouncy brand moment with a toy-like feel.
You have a wordmark and want the sting to supply a simple rounded mark beside it.
avoidWhen: Your real logo must appear exactly as designed: the mark here is a fixed rounded square with a dot, so wrap your logo with spotlight or orbit-lock.
The brand is serious or premium and the bounce reads as too playful: use anamorphic-flare.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Wordmark
variables.description: Wordmark that slides out beside the mark. Leave empty for the mark alone.
